feePolicy.description: WorldzLaunchPad permits a 0.50%–3.00% project trading-fee configuration only through supported launch routes. Ordinary wallet transfers carry 0% WorldzLaunchPad transfer tax. WorldzLaunchPad receives 10% of collected project trading-fee revenue, never token supply or initial liquidity.
feePolicy.publicPromise: WorldzLaunchPad takes 10% of the token's supported configured trading-fee revenue only — never 10% of token supply and never 10% of initial liquidity.

launchEngines.name: Worldz Flash™
launchEngines.description: Direct-liquidity Devnet launch with SPL token, Metaplex metadata, real CPMM pool and Worldz Proof registry.

launchEngines.name: Worldz Curve™
launchEngines.description: Raydium LaunchLab Devnet route with Worldz PlatformConfig, bonding curve, CPMM graduation path and native vesting records.

launchEngines.name: Worldz Curve Pro™
launchEngines.description: Meteora DBC Devnet route with per-launch fee configuration, native 90/10 partner/creator split, DAMM V2 graduation, permanent LP locking and optional locked vesting.

launchEngines.name: Worldz Liquidity™
launchEngines.description: Traditional fixed-supply token plus creator-funded liquidity.

launchEngines.name: Worldz Board™
launchEngines.description: Branded launch surface for a creator, community or team.

launchEngines.name: Worldz EVM Fair™
launchEngines.description: Base Sepolia fixed-supply token deployment with direct disclosed genesis allocation. Mainnet liquidity, fee-routing and LP-lock adapters remain fail-closed.

verifiedQuoteAssets.name: Hex Trust wrapped XRP
verifiedQuoteAssets.backing: 1:1 XRP held in custody by Hex Trust, subject to issuer terms and redemption controls

crossPair.name: Worldz CrossPair™
crossPair.rule: Public creators may select only verified quote assets supported by the selected launch engine. Pairing against a wrapped asset does not imply the creator token is backed by that asset.

omnichain.name: Worldz Omnichain™
omnichain.goal: Allow supported WorldzLaunchPad assets to operate across multiple chains while preserving a disclosed global supply model.
omnichain.rule: OmniChain is a common project/proof architecture. Each chain is executable only when its chain-native adapter is independently verified; a visual World does not imply a live launch adapter.

Worldz Reserve Treasury target capped at 6-of-9 approvals
atomic genesis distribution to tagged destinations

wXRP.reason: No official verified wXRP Devnet mint is used; WorldzLaunchPad does not fabricate one.

lockedTokenVesting.rule: When creator/team tokens are vested through Curve Pro, Worldz Safe Launch Standard v1 caps the allocation at 15% and requires at least a 90-day cliff and 18-month vesting period.

publicPositioning.headline: Public WorldzLaunchPad™
publicPositioning.rule: WorldzLaunchPad takes exactly 10% of the collected trading-fee revenue configured for a supported token launch route. The project keeps/routs the other 90%.

treasuryRouting.rule: Public mainnet fee routing must remain disabled until the chain-specific Operations Treasury is verified at 5-of-10 governance, the exact 10% fee-only route is proven end-to-end, and the applicable release gates pass.

verifiedEvidence.verification: Independent Solana mainnet Squads v4 account decode and vault derivation
verifiedEvidence.note: Multisig configuration and vault relationship are verified on-chain. Mainnet launch routing remains disabled until the exact 10% fee-only route and remaining release gates pass.

baseEvmFair.rule: Base Sepolia may deploy the Worldz fixed-supply template for public testing. It is not a complete Worldz mainnet launch until pool creation, LP lock, fee routing and server-side proof are implemented and verified.

founding100.name: WorldzLaunchPad Founding 100™
founding100.qualificationRule: A position is available only to a verified mainnet WorldzLaunchPad launch that passes the applicable Safe Launch Standard, on-chain proof, team identity/anti-sybil review and human/multisig qualification.
founding100.orderingRule: Mainnet proof completion creates a permanent candidate timestamp. Qualified positions are then assigned in order of verified qualification. Disqualified candidates remain documented and do not receive a position.
founding100.antiSybilRule: One qualified Founding 100 position per verified team identity. Multiple wallets do not create multiple team positions.
founding100.permanenceRule: Qualified positions are permanent historical records. A later fraud finding may mark a position disqualified/forfeited but the historical record is not deleted or silently reassigned.
founding100.allocationRule: 10% total future WORLDZ allocation pool is reserved for the 100 qualified Founding 100 positions, intended as 0.10% of total WORLDZ supply per position.

treasuryStandard.purpose: Chain-native WorldzLaunchPad treasury governance for the 10% Worldz share of collected supported project trading-fee revenue.

operationsTreasury.label: Worldz Operations Treasury
operationsTreasury.purpose: Primary per-chain collector for WorldzLaunchPad fee-share revenue and approved operating transfers.

reserveTreasury.label: Worldz Reserve Treasury
reserveTreasury.purpose: Long-term reserve vault funded only by approved transfers from the Operations Treasury.

treasuryStandard.routingRule: Supported launch fee route -> same-chain Worldz Operations Treasury (5-of-10) -> approved reserve sweep -> same-chain Worldz Reserve Treasury (6-of-9). No cross-chain address is treated as universal custody.
